comparison.objective: PR-1810 swipes a magnetic-stripe card once and returns it to a stand; the candidate adjusts and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1810 tests continuous slot tracking at bounded speed and orientation, whereas the candidate tests tool seating, countertorque, and articulated verification.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1810 scores a valid one-direction read and released card return; the candidate scores angular tolerance, lock retention, repeated motion, and hands-off clearance.
comparison.reason: The complete swipe rubrics establish a velocity-controlled constrained pass, not mechanical adjustment or locknut retention.
